name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: No IAEA access; Trump names a suspected nuclear site as a remaining target
state: The IAEA has had no access to Iranian sites and reported Iran to the UN Security Council on 1 Oct. Trump said on 31 Oct–1 Nov the US still had to deal with one or two targets, citing a suspected nuclear complex at Pickaxe Mountain (CBS). Iran links reopening Hormuz to resuming nuclear talks. US strikes on 2 Nov hit air-defence sites, not nuclear facilities (AP).
for_you: No direct effect outside the region; follow FCDO travel advice for the Middle East.
rubric_hit: No inspector access; credible strike threats = Watch

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates
AP — US strikes Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
